title: Niagara Falls Feel the Mist Night Tour: Journey & Firework Cruise
includes: Niagara City Cruises firework boat cruise
Ride on the Falls Incline Railway
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Experience the awe of Niagara Falls at night with this intimate guided walking tour. Start at the iconic Skylon Tower before descending into the depths of Journey Behind the Falls, where you’ll explore tunnels that provide a unique view of the Falls’ power. Then, board the Niagara City Cruise to sail close to the Horseshoe Falls, all while enjoying a stunning fireworks display from the water. This tour is perfect for small groups and offers an unforgettable perspective of this natural wonder.

- Small group size (max 10 people) for a personalized experience
- Includes admission to Journey Behind the Falls and Hornblower Cruise
- Spectacular views of Bridal Veil Falls, Horseshoe Falls, and American Falls
- Enjoy a fireworks show over the Falls from the boat on your cruise
